# Battle Born Injury Lawyers

> Las Vegas-based personal injury law firm with $100M+ in client recoveries, specializing in catastrophic injuries, medical malpractice, and accident claims across Nevada.

Battle Born Injury Lawyers is a full-service personal injury practice serving Las Vegas, Henderson, Reno, and throughout Nevada. The firm handles motor vehicle accidents, rideshare crashes, medical malpractice, brain injuries, and wrongful death cases on contingency with free consultations.
